author: bondmila (AI-assisted)
summary: Cancel narration on clock reversal or clock failure
details: Track the highest clock reading across begin/delivery/tick and cancellation. Stop audio and invalidate pending tickets on backward, failed, nonfinite or invalid clock reads. Recovery cannot revive old tickets. PR #41 remains draft with synthetic speech adapter and unfinished integration.
validation: Five new regression methods reproduced failures on the original implementation; all 20 narration tests pass after the fix. Checked publisher reruns repository/root tests/changelog/whitespace checks. No physical audio or device acceptance.
